name: factorial_mul_pow_le_factorial
statement: ∀ {m n : ℕ}, m ! * (m + 1) ^ n ≤ (m + n)! | m, 0 => by simp | m, n + 1 => by rw [← Nat.add_assoc, factorial_succ, Nat.mul_comm (_ + 1), Nat.pow_succ, ← Nat.mul_assoc] exact Nat.mul_le_mul factorial_mul_pow_le_factorial (succ_le_succ (le_add_right _ _))  theorem factorial_lt (hn : 0 < n) : n ! < m ! ↔ n < m

name: self_le_factorial
statement: ∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ n ! | 0 => Nat.zero_le _ | k + 1 => Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (Nat.one_le_of_lt k.factorial_pos)  theorem lt_factorial_self {n : ℕ} (hi : 3 ≤ n) : n < n !
